unstuck_said.text: Filed issue #4 "A nano:mainnet settlement leg where the block is the receipt — no separate HCS anchor, because the payment itself is the audit record". Argued the two-rail HCS design exists because receipt-anchor and payment-settle are separate on EVM/Hedera; on Nano the block is the receipt — the buyer send is simultaneously payment and audit record, no HCS step. Offered the live Vend endpoint (extract.paypercall.dev/api/v1/status, 0.0001 XNO) to demo a guard receipt against a real send block. Public research disclosed in the issue.
